text: Specialized Bicycle Components was wholly owned by its founder Mike Sinyard until June 2001, when the Taiwanese bicycle maker Merida took a minority stake; Sinyard kept control as the majority shareholder. Merida Industry Co. owned 35% of Specialized in March 2025.
short: Specialized is controlled by its founder Mike Sinyard; Taiwan's Merida owns 35%.

source.name: Bicycle Retailer and Industry News: Merida writes down $105 million impairment related to Specialized investment
source.quote: Taiwanese manufacturer Merida Industry Co., which owns 35% of Specialized Bicycle Company

additionalSources.name: BikeBiz: Merida takes stake in Specialized
additionalSources.quote: He retains full control over the company as the majority shareholder and president/CEO.
